versions.changelog: Front matter parses again, so name and description load in every client. Fee section now matches the current Sato Route schedule at satohub.ai/pricing. Install-hook and tool references refreshed.
Display name fix only (was shown as 'Stage Sato Hub'). Content identical to 1.2.2.
Front matter parses again (skill loaded with empty metadata in 1.2.0/1.2.1); accurate listing text: keyless, signs nothing, holds no keys.

Sato Check: onchain_agent_check_install — before a crypto package, MCP server or skill is installed, what it can do with the agent's keys and money (four answers, each with declared / traced / observed evidence).
Tool reference: 35 tools (adds get_data_freshness, search_listings, inspect_listing); 31 read-only.
Runnable agent packages: search_listings and inspect_listing workflow; verify downloads against the published key

- Initial release of sato-hub: a read-only skill to query the daily-updated Sato Hub index of onchain agent tooling, protocols, and agent-economy stats.
- Enables discovery and evaluation of crypto agent frameworks, wallets, payment rails (x402, stablecoins), identity standards (ERC-8004), and venues, with Sato Score assessments and citable records.
- Provides access to agent-economy adoption numbers, preflight safety checks for repos/packages/tokens, and transparent fee disclosures for routing actions like swaps and launches.
- Supports plain-language goal-to-plan workflows, verification of project maintenance and provenance, and agent passport lookups.
- Keyless, outbound network access to https://satohub.ai/api/mcp required; use via REST, bash script, or MCP client integration.
- All catalog data is CC-BY-4.0 licensed (attribution: "data by satohub.ai").
